Container.Name: openclaw
Container.Overview: Unofficial, LinuxServer.io-style Docker image for the OpenClaw AI assistant gateway (upstream: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) - not affiliated with OpenClaw or LinuxServer.io. Uses the PUID/PGID + s6-overlay model so /config is owned by your chosen UID/GID with no manual chown; on Unraid keep PUID=99 / PGID=100 to match appdata ownership. Provide a gateway token and (optionally) an Anthropic API key. The Control UI is served on port 18789. The gateway serves plain HTTP and relies on a front TLS terminator (Tailscale serve or a reverse proxy) for HTTPS - do not expose port 18789 directly to the internet. For a hardened setup set OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH=false and OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to your UI URL, and open the UI via its https URL. amd64 only; image tracks upstream, checked daily and rebuilt only when something changed.
Container.Description: LinuxServer.io-style OpenClaw gateway (PUID/PGID + s6-overlay). Config, state and workspace persist under /config.
Container.Changes:
### Unreleased
**Two behaviour changes.**
1. OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH now defaults to **false** for new installs. Existing installs keep whatever they already have - your saved template value is not rewritten, so nothing breaks on update. OpenClaw's own startup check flags `true` as a dangerous flag; leave it false unless you reach the dashboard over plain HTTP with no TLS in front.
2. The gateway's inbound bind is now conditional. With **Use Tailscale + Serve** enabled it binds loopback (Serve proxies to it inside the container), otherwise `lan` as before. If you run Tailscale **and** a published 18789 port, or something on the docker network reaches into the gateway, set the new advanced variable **OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND=lan** to restore the old behaviour.
Also: the upstream OpenClaw image is now pinned by digest and recorded on the image, the build no longer installs Node from a third-party script, and unchanged rebuilds are skipped - so you should stop seeing update prompts for rebuilds that change nothing.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: OpenClaw gateway / Control UI port

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent config, state and workspace (the container's ~/.openclaw lives here)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns /config. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns /config. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Umask for files the container creates.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone (e.g. America/New_York).

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN
Config.Description: Auth token for the gateway. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Leave blank if configured another way.

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH
Config.Description: Leave false. Set true only if you reach the dashboard over plain HTTP with no TLS in front - without it, pairing will fail on a plain-HTTP LAN address.

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowed origins for the Control UI (CSRF/origin protection on a non-loopback bind). Set to the URL you reach the UI from, e.g. https://openclaw.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net. Strongly recommended.

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND
Config.Description: Advanced. Which address the gateway listens on for INBOUND connections. Leave empty: the container uses 127.0.0.1 when Tailscale Serve is enabled (Serve runs inside the container and proxies to loopback) and lan otherwise. Set to lan if something else must reach in - a reverse proxy, a dashboard widget, or another container using the OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Does not affect OpenClaw reaching OUT to other containers.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. OpenAI API key, if using OpenAI models.

Config.Name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. OpenRouter API key.

Config.Name: GEMINI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Google Gemini API key.

Config.Name: GROQ_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Groq API key.

Config.Name: XAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. xAI (Grok) API key.

Config.Name: ZAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Z.AI API key.

Config.Name: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. GitHub token for Copilot models.

Config.Name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Discord bot token for the Discord channel.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Telegram bot token for the Telegram channel.

Config.Name: BRAVE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Brave Search API key for web search.
